Zoe Lin: Proposal: make autoscaler "fabric-aware" — consult quick network/ENI attach signals per-AZ before permitting surge starts.
Kai Patel: Interesting. Which signals? packet loss? ENI attach latency? route table errors?
Ram Singh: We already emit ENI attach latency and DHCP error counts from the launcher. Those tracked with launch retries last week in eu-west-1.
Zoe Lin: Plan: compute az_fabric_score in [0..1] from a 30s sliding window of attach-fail-rate + RTT spikes. If >0.6 treat AZ as "soft-degraded" and throttle surge there.
Sarah M.: How will fleets opt in? Dedicated customers will want deterministic rules.
Zoe Lin: Config inheritance: global defaults, per-fleet override. Defaults: allowed_surge_per_az=0.2, soft_degrade_threshold=0.6, max_backoff=5m.
Kai Patel: Scale-out trigger should remain multi-signal. I suggest: queue_depth>Q && p99_latency>LAT && (az_fabric_score < soft_threshold OR hedging_decision==true).
Zoe Lin: If az_fabric_score >= soft_threshold and predicted_preempt_prob > 0.3, route placement to hedged_pools (different family/region) and perform cost check.
Ram Singh: Hedged_pools = mix of reserved/on-demand + spot from other families/azs. Need warm-standby heuristics by region for latency-critical fleets.
Zoe Lin: Heuristic: warm_standby = max(2, ceil(steady_gpu_count * 0.05)) for latency-critical. Best-effort fleets default to 0.
ops-lead: infra-bot: schedule canary deploy? :eyes:
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: autoscaler/fabric-aware -> staging canary (5% fleets) at 2026-03-24T09:00Z; CI ok; brownout probe ON.
Kai Patel: Implementation detail: apply soft gating multiplicatively: allowed = base_allowed_surge * (1 - az_fabric_score). So score 0.7 => allowed drops 70%.
Ram Singh: Add cooldown on fabric_score flips. If an AZ heals within 30s allow a single emergency scale (force one node) to avoid prolonged underprovisioning.
Sarah M.: Cost impact: hedging will increase per-token unit cost. Need max_extra_cost_pct per-fleet to reject hedged placements if too expensive.
Zoe Lin: We'll add cost_budget param and planner will compute estimated delta before committing. If delta > cost_budget, skip hedging and queue longer.
Kai Patel: Config example:
```
autoscaler:
  heuristics: [queue_depth, p99_latency, az_fabric_score, preempt_prob]
  az_fabric:
    window: 30s
    soft_degrade_threshold: 0.6
    flip_cooldown: 30s
  surge_control:
    allowed_surge_per_az: 0.2
    backoff: exponential
  hedging:
    warm_standby_pct: 0.05
    min_warm_standby: 2
    max_extra_cost_pct: 10
    fallback_families: [a2, p5, rtx]
```
Zoe Lin: Action items:
- Kai + Ram: instrument az_fabric_score, ENI-fail dashboards by region (ETA 2d)
- Zoe: add cost-estimation call into planner + default fleet configs (ETA 1d)
- Sarah: draft Dedicated opt-in wording and pricing caveat (ETA 3d)
Kai Patel: I'll also write a short ops runbook: how to force-disable hedging and how on-call should respond to persistent AZ fabric degradation.
Zoe Lin: Let's watch staging Canary metrics closely. If brownout probe trips we'll pause rollout. :thumbsup:
